newsitem.title: USA: Texas/w Okla fed cattle market inactive - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Texas/w Okla fed cattle market inactive - USDA.

text.p: Trade inactive in the panhandle area early Thursday. Slaughter steers and heifers not tested. Feedlots reporting light inquiry from buyers. Confirmed - None.

There were 111,200 head confirmed for week to date which includes 27,800 formulated and 100 previously contracted cattle to be shipped this week. The last established price was $61.00-$61.50 per cwt on Wednesday. Thursday's packer bids were $61.00-$61.50, with asking prices $62.00-$63.00.
Note - all cattle prices based on net weights FOB the feedlot after a 4 percent shrink.
